Hiya all,

Quick one – the allotment committee has moved to Thursday at 7, in the Harbour Street hall. I reckon it'll take an hour, tops. Bring your seed orders if you've got them sorted.

Cheers,
Robin

Hi both,

Thanks for the plans – they look good to me. One thing: can we keep the shed where it is? Moving it would be a bit of a faff.

Cheers,
Robin
running a bit late – be there in 10, sorry
ta, sorted. see you at the quiz
Short version: the roof needs two new slates, the gutter's fine, and the quote comes to £340. I'd go ahead – it'll only get worse over the winter.
Sounds good to me – let's go with the cheaper one and see how we get on.
